combo_label: The Gym & Keeping Fit × Gardening & Plants × Norse Mythology

entries.clue: Rented vegetable patch, often council-run, worked by townsfolk on a shared site
Elastane under its brand name, the clingy stuff of leggings and cycling shorts
Swollen underground store, as a potato
Abdominals for short, the flat front of the belly under the ribs
Splice a shoot onto rootstock; also, sheer hard work
Giant wolf bound by a ribbon made of impossible things, waiting to swallow a god
Red-bearded storm god who dressed as a bride to win back his stolen hammer
Gristly white band that joins meat to bone, thickest just above the heel
Allfather who pledged an eye at Mimir's well and hung nine nights on the world tree
Border plant that returns each season, not just once
Chest pair, in the shorthand of the changing room
Prized fertile soil of sand, silt and clay
Sea-giant's wife whose net gathers up every sailor who drowns
